definitions: A painful condition that affects the knee, primarily in adolescents, caused by inflammation of the patellar ligament at the tibial tuberosity.
A common cause of knee pain in growing adolescents, especially those involved in sports, characterized by a painful lump below the kneecap.
examples: He was diagnosed with Osgood-Schlatter disease.
Osgood-Schlatter disease often resolves with rest.
Managing Osgood-Schlatter disease involves pain relief.
